Class AdminImpl

java.lang.Object
com.flipfit.business.AdminImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AdminInterface
public class AdminImpl extends Object implements AdminInterface
The Class AdminImpl. This class contains business logic related to administrative operations such as: - Approving gym owners - Approving gym centers It validates the outcome of DAO operations and throws appropriate exceptions on failure.
